T-001.Title: Findings retirement window: pre-move base in the ceiling min

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Amend scripts/validate-record-retirement.ts and scripts/validate-record-retirement.test.ts. On entry to the snapshot rewrite in retireRecord, capture Base_live as the newline count of findings.xml as read, before any spans are removed. persistSnapshot gains an optional ceilingBase parameter defaulting to base; the formula term becomes ceilingBase + computedHeadroom, and headroom is always ceiling - base. The findings withRootSnapshot call passes ceilingBase = Base_live and base = newlineCount of the post-move findingsLive, so ceiling = min(previous ceiling, Base_live + H) and headroom = ceiling - base = Delta_retired + H when the formula term sets the ceiling. Rulings, registry, and index call sites are unchanged (ceilingBase defaults to base), so their behaviour is identical: when the formula term sets the ceiling, ceiling - base = computedHeadroom, and when the clamp binds, headroom = ceiling - base. Fixtures prove: (1) a fixture findings file grown by hand with one eligible finding, --retire persists the previous ceiling when Base_live + H meets or exceeds it, base = the post-move count, and headroom = ceiling - base (the window opened is Delta_retired + H minus the growth the fixture applied); (2) anti-ratchet: a fixture whose Base_live + H exceeds the persisted ceiling persists the previous ceiling, and a no-min recompute that raises the ceiling fails the probe; (3) min not decorative: a hand-shrunk live findings file persists ceiling = Base_live + H; (4) Delta = 0: a --retire moving only a decision leaves an unchanged findings file at window H when the snapshot sat at base + H; (5) after any successful move, every live root's persisted triple satisfies base + headroom = ceiling. The predicate isFirstRulingsRewrite and the rulings discriminator are left in place in this task; the rulings clamp branch is untouched.

T-002.Title: Remove the spent one-time rulings exception

T-003.Title: Validator-asserted provenance ceiling on the rulings genre
